name: What preparation is required before installing floor or wall tile?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is required before installing floor or wall tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: A durable tile job requires a completely flat, rigid, and clean subfloor before any mortar is mixed. Installers inspect the underlying framing and subfloor to ensure it meets structural deflection standards, as bouncy floors cause cracked tiles and failing grout lines. The subfloor is then leveled, and cementitious backer board or an uncoupling membrane is secured over the base. In wet zones like showers or tub surrounds, full waterproofing membranes are applied to protect adjacent drywall and framing before any tile or marble is set.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation involves checking subfloor rigidity, leveling uneven spots, installing backer board or uncoupling membranes, and applying waterproofing in wet areas.
